requirements.requirement: Test local web applications by writing native Python Playwright scripts.
Run a helper script with `--help` before using it.
Do not read a helper script's source unless running it showed that a customized solution is absolutely necessary.
requirements.quote: DO NOT read the source until you try running the script first

requirements.requirement: Before writing custom code, consider whether a bundled script in `scripts/` can do the job, and use it as a black box.
requirements.quote: consider whether one of the scripts available in `scripts/` can help

requirements.requirement: For static HTML, read the HTML file directly to identify selectors; if that fails or is incomplete, treat the app as dynamic.
requirements.quote: Read HTML file directly to identify selectors

requirements.requirement: For a dynamic app whose server is not running, use `scripts/with_server.py` (after `--help`) to manage the server.
When inspecting a dynamic app (not static HTML), wait for `networkidle` before inspecting the DOM; the wait is not required for static HTML.
requirements.quote: inspect the DOM before waiting for `networkidle` on dynamic apps

requirements.requirement: Reconnaissance before action: inspect the rendered page (screenshot or DOM), identify selectors from it, then act with those selectors.
Automation scripts contain only Playwright logic; the helper manages servers.
requirements.quote: include only Playwright logic (servers are managed automatically)
Always launch chromium in headless mode

requirements.requirement: Always close the browser when done.
requirements.quote: Always close the browser when done

requirements.requirement: Use descriptive selectors (`text=`, `role=`, CSS selectors or IDs).
